sachs.consequence: Scores on the Sachs arms are agreement with the repo's 19-edge graph. At least three versions exist (19, 17 and 20 edges); the repo's and bnlearn's share 16 adjacencies and differ in 1 direction(s); CausalArena's 20-edge list is not available here. Scores are not accuracy and are not comparable to CausalArena's Sachs row.

abalone.consequence: Counts match CausalArena's indexed version; the tables are not republished there, so identity is not confirmed. The graph is an expert graph with no second version here to compare against.

autompg.consequence: Does not match CausalArena's version (variables, edges, rows differ); scores are agreement with the repo's graph only and must not be set beside CausalArena's Auto MPG row.

concrete.consequence: Counts match CausalArena's indexed version; the tables are not republished there, so identity is not confirmed. The graph is an expert graph with no second version here to compare against.

s2_01.consequence: The reference is the graph the data were simulated from; scores are accuracy against the generating graph. The scenario and its names were written by CausalArena's generator, so a model may recognise the domain story but cannot have seen this graph unless it saw the release.
